subject.title: feat: auto-detect provider usage and billing stats

question: Should OpenClaw make provider usage discovery and structured billing data a first-class core/plugin contract for the Usage dashboard now, and what billing fields are approved for that contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested work crosses plugin SDK compatibility, provider auth, external provider API semantics, and Control UI product design, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent schema or discovery behavior.

options.title: Define Additive Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify provider-owned discovery plus structured billing fields before implementation begins.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
options.body: Use this issue as the umbrella and move provider-specific hooks or UI placements into focused issues linked back here.

options.title: Decline Dashboard Billing
options.body: Keep provider billing visibility in status, CLI, and narrower usage surfaces, then close only after a maintainer explicitly rejects Usage dashboard cards.

recommendation.title: Define Additive Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify provider-owned discovery plus structured billing fields before implementation begins.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the request and have the strongest provider-usage and Usage UI history in the affected paths.
